title: Strata Policy Suggester: simulate recommendations and safe staged commit
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a recommendation engine and safe-apply workflow for per-customer and per-route batching/caching policies. The feature generates ranked policy suggestions (allowlist/denylist, tier caps, cache TTLs, batching thresholds) using a traffic-replay simulator and past telemetry, exposes an estimated cost delta + risk score, and provides a staged canary commit flow with automatic validation and rollback hooks. Deliverables: (1) offline scorer that computes candidate policy impacts from historical traces, (2) dry-run simulator that replays sampled traffic to produce quality and latency regressions per-customer, (3) console surface for reviewing suggestions and running a policy dry-run, (4) staged apply pipeline (canary -> tiered rollout) with automatic rollback conditions and audit logging.
comments: 2026-03-06 — Initial architecture sync: decided to reuse trace sampling library from ENG-241034 to minimize instrumentation work.

2026-03-08 — Spike results: offline scorer prototype (scorer/v0) produces 3 candidate caching profiles per-route with estimated token-cost delta and a calibrated risk score. Raw notebook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COST/strata-scorer-spike

2026-03-09 — Design review with PM & Console: PM asked for explicit per-customer opt-out and an explanation string for every suggestion. Action: add 'explainability' field to suggestion output (why this candidate helps, which traffic slices it affects).

2026-03-10 — Security review request created (sec-review-1123) to validate that simulated dry-run cannot exfiltrate PII. Security requested a data-minimization pass; we will hash prompt prefixes before storing simulation payloads.
2026-03-11 — Integration note: backend will store suggestions in the Policy Suggestions DB (schema v2). Frontend PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/7683 (WIP).

2026-03-12 — Risk gating: added automated rollback conditions — if latency P50 increases >30ms for canary cohort OR quality regression (BLEU/rouge/threshold) exceeds per-route bounds, trigger rollback and notify SRE channel.
Next steps: complete simulator end-to-end, wire telemetry checks into rollout controller, create E2E playbook and run with two pilot customers (customer-a, customer-b) in sandbox account.
acceptance_criteria: Scorer outputs at least 2 ranked suggestions per route with estimated cost delta and a normalized risk score
Dry-run simulator can replay representative traffic for a selected customer and produce per-token latency and quality deltas in the dashboard
Console shows suggestions with explainability copy, impact estimates, and a one-click 'simulate' action that triggers the dry-run for a selectable cohort
Staged apply pipeline supports canary (1% traffic), tiered rollout (10%/50%/100%), and automatic rollback based on latency and quality thresholds
All policy applies and rollbacks produce audit logs with user, timestamp, diff, and linked dry-run ID
Security sign-off completed (sec-review-1123) confirming no raw prompt storage in persistent logs and hashed payloads used for simulation
